notes.title: Community Items Announcing
notes.content:
Our game is getting closer to release and we are happy to announce community items prepared by us, which we will be able to release [b]only with your support[/b], in order to unlock community items we need to reach some indicators of player activity , so if you like the items[b] add the game to your wishlist[/b] and tell your friends about it, we really need your support on release!
[h2]Cards:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310390/f7eb005392cc83e3d93024ee925af989208b3718.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310390/83056475a951eda749405a028d91f6beb25b61d3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310390/6c75718405d7915bdcbfbfa7ce61983e46a762c9.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310390/bd7d835bf58c231cd35585a99f65d9eaa644a8a1.png[/img]
[h2]Backgrounds:[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310390/f9480747e44758e8bcaff320810907453ec0d6c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44310390/b064eeb094e2bc9859ee67f071bf3b6408ef285b.png[/img]

[h3]Note[/h3]
This is only a small part of the content that we can release, after unlocking this feature we can release 5 backgrounds, 15 cards, 5 emoticons and 5 badges + metal one! As well as many animated backgrounds and emoticons with dances! Let`s do it together!
 
[h3]Stay with us[/h3]
You can also subscribe to our group:
https://steamcommunity.com/groups/GosDev
And to our curatorial group:
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GosDev
Closer to the release, we will giveaway keys and customization items there!
With all questions and suggestions feel free to write to GosDevProduction@gmail.com
